response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM matched), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM matched GROUP BY transref, tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg AS deviation FROM pairs AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind
